summary: Iteration 3 verified the optimized frontend build, sales login, dashboard, new-order POST/persistence/search/detail flow, mobile navigation, lifecycle timeline, unique-account lockout, cookies, and GridFS API coverage. Core browser flow passes; the configured public origin is still canonicalized by ingress and the backend regression suite is contaminated by the intentionally locked admin account.

minor.issue: Requests with Origin=https://pinaki-crm.preview.emergentagent.com receive Access-Control-Allow-Origin=https://pinaki-crm.cluster-2.preview.emergentcf.cloud instead of echoing the configured public origin. Credentials are allowed and browser login currently works, but explicit-origin consumers/regression checks fail.

The suite locks the shared seeded admin during brute-force testing and then runs other admin-dependent tests, causing 7 subsequent 429 failures. The isolated unique-email probe correctly returned five 401 responses followed by 429.

integration_issues.issue: GridFS upload API is working, but Order Detail has no file input or upload control, so users cannot perform the promised persistent document upload from the UI.

action_items: Resolve preview ingress/CORS origin canonicalization so the configured public origin receives the explicit allow-origin header.
Make brute-force regression tests use a unique test email or reset only test attempt state so lockout coverage does not block the shared admin fixture.
Expose the existing GridFS document upload endpoint in Order Detail with a file input, upload state, and linked document result.
critical_code_review_comments: Most connected workspace modules still render ComingSoon summaries rather than operational records/actions; this is a scope gap for the requested complete CRM lifecycle.

NewOrderModal calls window.location.reload() after POST, returning the user to Dashboard instead of preserving the Orders context or showing a success state; creation works but this is a rough integration experience.

success_rate.backend: 46% executed assertions passed (6/13; remaining failures were admin lockout contamination, not endpoint regressions)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of executed browser flows passed; production build passed

seed_data_creation: Created one TEST UI sample signage order through the UI for POST, persistence, search, and detail verification. Unique nonexistent email was used for isolated lockout testing; no seeded users or clients were modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use sales@pinakisolutions.com for UI until the shared admin lock expires. New order PS-2609-5279 is present as a test record. Recheck CORS after ingress/config changes and add UI document upload coverage; backend GridFS upload itself passed in prior regression coverage.
rca of the issue: CORS middleware includes a broad preview-origin regex, while the public ingress rewrites/canonicalizes the Origin response to the cluster-2 hostname. The test suite uses the shared admin email for five failed attempts, and the API correctly persists that lock for 15 minutes; later admin tests therefore receive 429. The document upload route exists in server.py, but App.js has no upload component or invocation.
